ModMetaData.name: Flavor Text Extended - Français - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Flavor Text Extended - Français, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Fifteen features: loading and load order, English isolation, French text and grammar reaching the defs, the settings page and its hidden shortcut (captured, tagged @review), the language of the pass, meal naming without a stove, captures of French meals, unlisted ingredients, a filmed cook, a two-launch restart test, and (features 12 to 15, pass 7 only) RIMMSQOL revealing and hiding the shortcut, alone and across three launches, through the shared steps of PickleTools/RimmsqolSteps. They need the companion steps assembly built from Tests/Pickle/Source against Mod/Assemblies/FlavorTextExtendedFR.dll and Flavor Text's own FlavorText.dll. The English pass has been played; the French pass and the optional-mods pass are pending. See TESTING.md at the repository root for the passes and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is deliberately left out.
